answer: Dune-thread beacon liveness bond: each identity runs one dune thread, locks 70, answers each random-hour beacon checkpoint. It must report its dune reading before the checkpoint closes; auditors replay the log against the beacon seed; a miss or copy burns the bond. First proof 34, kth 34+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,530,500 + 70,000 locked, vs at most 40,000 rewards. Rented threads fail: each log needs its plot key. Honest agents pay 34 per epoch.
